session_bus_enabled.description: Whether colord registers on the session bus (typically not needed on headless systems).

database_path.description: Path to the persistent database storing device and profile metadata.

cache_dir.description: Directory used for temporary profile storage during upload or processing.

max_cache_size.description: Maximum total size (in bytes) of cached profiles. Set to 0 for unlimited.

vendor_profiles_enabled.description: Allow automatic installation of vendor-provided color profiles.

embedded_profiles_enabled.description: Allow use of embedded ICC profiles found in devices (e.g., monitors).

upload_enabled.description: Enable uploading of ICC profiles via D-Bus (e.g., from user applications).

vendor_profile_dirs.description: List of directories scanned for vendor-provided ICC profiles. Each entry includes a path and optional human-readable description.

path.description: Absolute path to a directory containing ICC profile files.

description.description: Optional description shown in UIs (not used by colord daemon itself).

system_profile_dirs.description: List of directories scanned for system-wide ICC profiles (e.g., installed by packages).

path.description: Absolute path to a directory containing ICC profile files.

description.description: Optional description shown in UIs (not used by colord daemon itself).

lcms_enabled.description: Enable the internal LCMS2 color management engine for profile processing.

display_calibration_enabled.description: Enable experimental display calibration support (requires external tools like argyll).

hwc_enabled.description: Enable support for Hardware Color (HWC) devices, where available (e.g., some laptops with integrated sensors).

max_workers.description: Maximum number of worker threads for background profile processing.

device_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a device to become ready before timing out.

debug_enabled.description: Enable verbose debug logging to syslog.
